name: Devanshu Sharma
short_biography: Rocket.Chat developer, GSoC alumnus, and mentor working on backend and AI projects.
long_biography: Devanshu is a backend developer at Rocket.Chat, a GSoC alumnus, and a returning mentor. He enjoys building open-source systems and exploring practical applications of LLMs and AI moderation.

name: Srijna Bhargav
short_biography: B.Tech student passionate about open source, backend development, and building software that solves real-world problems.
long_biography: Srijna discovered open source through the Rocket.Chat community and quickly grew to enjoy building, asking questions, learning from mentors, and collaborating with people around the world. She is especially interested in backend development and AI and is always ready to explore the next project that catches her attention.

name: Meet Jain
short_biography: Software engineer who enjoys adapting to new stacks, untangling difficult problems, and shipping useful open-source software.
long_biography: Meet's path into software started with curiosity and a friendly competition. After an initial GSoC rejection, he returned with a stronger understanding of open source, kept contributing, and earned the opportunity to build with Rocket.Chat. He enjoys learning through difficult problems, connecting with the community, music, and the occasional attempt to touch grass between deploys.

name: Devansh Kansagra
short_biography: Software developer who enjoys building reliable full-stack applications and solving real-world problems through open source.
long_biography: Devansh works across frontend and backend development, with a focus on reliable, scalable, and maintainable applications. Contributing to open-source projects has taught him how to solve complex bugs, improve established features, collaborate with experienced maintainers, and write production-quality software.

name: Kartik Doda
short_biography: Developer and Linux enthusiast interested in agents, backend engineering, DevOps, and crypto.
long_biography: Kartik started coding with Java and Kotlin before moving into web3 and remote product development. After working across web3 games and a trading platform, he began contributing to Rocket.Chat and was selected for GSoC 2026. He is spending the summer going deeper into backend engineering and DevOps.

name: Amit Ashutosh
short_biography: Computer Science graduate interested in open source, TypeScript, terminal applications, and developer tools.
long_biography: Amit is a Computer Science graduate from India and a GSoC 2026 contributor at Rocket.Chat. He enjoys understanding systems under the hood and working with TypeScript, React, terminal UI frameworks, and software architecture. Through open source, he is developing his production engineering, testing, and collaboration skills.

name: Aryan Verma
short_biography: AI solutions engineer and open-source contributor working on the next generation of Rocket.Chat EmbeddedChat.
long_biography: Aryan found EmbeddedChat in late 2025 and jumped directly into a complex Matrix federation issue. Working through mistakes with patient mentorship turned that first contribution into a sustained open-source journey. He now applies that experience to accessibility, federation, modern APIs, and AI integrations for EmbeddedChat.

name: Khizar Shah
position: Computer Science Student & Open Source Contributor
short_biography: Computer Science student who enjoys building developer tools, full-stack applications, and useful open-source products.
long_biography: Khizar is a fourth-year Computer Science student who learns by building. Open source has helped him work on real-world projects, collaborate with experienced maintainers, and develop production engineering skills. He also enjoys experimenting with product ideas and creating software that reaches real users.

name: Sezal Lagwal
position: Computer Science Student & Open Source Contributor
short_biography: Computer Science student from Himachal Pradesh interested in backend development, real-time systems, and open source.
long_biography: Sezal is a third-year Computer Science student from Himachal Pradesh, India. She enjoys learning by building, exploring how software works, experimenting with side projects, and working with backend and real-time technologies that solve practical problems.

name: Echo Xiao
short_biography: Data-driven builder turning complex AI concepts into practical, high-impact solutions.
long_biography: Echo studies at Georgia Tech in the United States and works on applied AI systems that can adapt between technical analysis and collaborative execution. Her GSoC project explores agentic code understanding for large software repositories.

name: Rahian Santos
position: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer & Computer Science Student
short_biography: Brazilian full-stack developer focused on scalable UI architecture, type safety, accessibility, and open source.
long_biography: Rahian is a Computer Science student and full-stack JavaScript developer from Brazil. As a GSoC 2026 contributor at Rocket.Chat, he works with TypeScript, React, Jest, and Playwright to build robust, accessible interfaces. He enjoys understanding systems under the hood, refactoring legacy code, and improving developer workflows.
